description: This file defines CLI commands for voice call utilities, including initiating calls, managing call states, tailing logs, and configuring Tailscale webhook exposure. It imports modules for filesystem, OS, path, and external command management, and interacts with voice call runtime and webhook setup functions.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Defines logging methods: info, warn, error

methods.name: writeStdoutLine
methods.description: Writes formatted output to stdout with newline

methods.name: writeStdoutJson
methods.description: Outputs a JSON string to stdout

methods.name: resolveDefaultStorePath
methods.description: Determines default path for voice call logs

methods.name: percentile
methods.description: Calculates the p-th percentile of a number array

methods.name: summarizeSeries
methods.description: Summarizes latency series with count, min, max, average, p50, p95

methods.name: resolveCallMode
methods.description: Resolves call mode string to 'notify' or 'conversation'

methods.name: initiateCallAndPrintId
methods.description: Initiates a voice call and outputs call ID

methods.name: registerVoiceCallCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for voice call operations
